Rina (PM): quick idea: make a compact DP selection playbook so we stop debating edge cases in DMs.
Omar (Eng): yes please. ops can't support many simultaneous high-touch partners.
Priya (ProdOps): propose hard cap 6 active, max 3 high-touch. reserve 1 slot for rapid follow-ups.
Luca (Research): scoring should reward recorded sessions + repeat evals. those give the best signals.
Maya (Design): product coverage matters. aim for at least 3 different verticals per quarter and one small startup case.
Rina (PM): draft weight: engagement 30%, strategic_value 25%, domain_fit 20%, feedback_depth 15%, compliance_risk 10%.
Omar (Eng): flag heavy compliance as a "private-deploy" path; don't auto-exclude.
Luca (Research): simple numeric score (0-1): score = 0.3*eng + 0.25*strat + 0.2*domain + 0.15*fb + 0.1*(1-risk)
Maya (Design): add a soft "infra-leverage" tag for partners that exercise vector DBs, streaming, or tool-calls. use it for tie-breaks.
Priya (ProdOps): intake must capture: avg prompt length, concurrency, p95 latency need, sensitive data boolean.
Rina (PM): timeline: shortlist next Wed, outreach next Mon, onboard wave 1 by month-end. 6-week loop with mid and final reviews.
Omar (Eng): DP->beta gate: >=75% participation rate, no unresolved infra blockers, measurable win on one metric.
join-bot: reminder scheduled 12024-05-03T12:00:00Z to ping for mid-wave review.
Priya (ProdOps): action items: I'll update intake + automations.
Luca (Research): will build scoring sheet.
Maya (Design): I'll map vertical targets.
Omar (Eng): adding infra fields to intake now.
Rina (PM): I'll publish the 1-pager after collating updates. thanks all.
